snippet.text:
structure FieldCore (W : Surface S) (R : S.Rotation) (h : S.RealSpin) (F : Wightman S) : Prop where
  induced : starRead F.J h
  letters : F.spin.Descends R h
  total : F.operators.Total
  adj : F.operators.sharpPair F.J
  meets : F.operators.realizes W
  localPairs : F.operators.commutes
  faithful : F.operators.notLost
  covariance : Symmetries F.spin F.action
  spectral : F.action.orbit.Spectrum F.momentum
  forward : F.momentum.region Mink.coneᶜ=0

proof_context.conclusion: `FieldCore` packages a Hilbert space with field operators on a common word domain: adjoint law `adj`, `total`, `meets`, `localPairs`, `faithful`, `covariance`, `spectral`, and `forward` (spectrum in the forward cone), without vacuum uniqueness.

snippet.text:
theorem establishing (H : Bid.Pantry S T V X.derivatives A)
    (hk : K.Descends X.turns H.head.spin) (hj : starRead J H.head.spin)
    (hY : Show.Reveals X K J Y W) :
    ∃ F : Wightman S, F.J=J ∧ F.spin=K ∧ FieldCore W X.turns H.head.spin F := by
  obtain ⟨a, e⟩ := Show.uses hY

proof_context.conclusion: `establishing` constructs a `Wightman` structure `F` with `FieldCore W X.turns h F` from the revealed boundary.

snippet.text:
structure Wightman.Realizes {W : Surface S} (R : Wightman S) (V : S.Rotation) (h : S.RealSpin) : Prop where
  induced : starRead R.J h
  letters : R.spin.Descends V h
  total : R.operators.Total
  adj : R.operators.sharpPair R.J
  meets : R.operators.realizes W
  localPairs : R.operators.commutes
  faithful : R.operators.notLost
  covariance : Symmetries R.spin R.action
  spectral : R.action.orbit.Spectrum R.momentum
  forward : R.momentum.region Mink.coneᶜ = 0
  unique (v : R.operators.H) : (∀ x, R.action.orbit.translation x v=v) → ∃ z : ℂ, z • R.operators.vacuum=v

proof_context.conclusion: `Realizes` adds the vacuum uniqueness clause `unique` to the field-core clauses, the only remaining item.
